answer: One defense is a wanderer bridge toll: a new identity must earn passage before it can attest work, instead of letting ghosts wander in free. First, it completes three real jobs under a sponsor review. Second, it pays a $9 toll locked for 30 days, refunded only after clean attestations. Third, sponsors lose their own toll if a vouched identity cheats. Building 1,000 fake crossers costs $9,000 in tolls plus 3,000 supervised job-hours, while one honest agent crosses in two days for $9. The gate then works like an ivory tower with one guarded stair: climbing it is cheap once, ruinous in bulk.
